seoTitle: Free Big-O Cheatsheet: Sorting, Data Structures and Graph Algorithms
metaDescription: A searchable Big-O cheatsheet with time and space complexity for sorting, search, data structures and graph algorithms, plus step counts for your n.
intro: A compact table of time and space complexity for common sorting algorithms, searches, data structures and graph algorithms, and a growth table showing how many steps O(n log n), O(n^2) or O(2^n) need for an input size you choose.
why:
Complexity tables are easy to half remember: is quicksort worst case n log n or n squared, and does heapsort need extra space? A quick lookup beats guessing in an interview or a design review.

The values are standard textbook figures and were not re-checked against a source for this build. Big-O hides constants, memory access and the shape of your data, so a fast-growing function can still win on small inputs.
howTo: Type a word such as sort or graph to filter the table, or leave it empty.
Set n to see how many steps each growth class needs.
Compare rows for the structure or algorithm you are choosing.

faq.q: What does the growth table show?
faq.a: The raw value of each function at your n. It is not a timing.
It grows past what a number can hold quickly, so large cases show a text note.
Where average and worst differ, both are shown.
No. It covers common cases only.
